cells.gaps: No source found names a body set up or named to carry out the strategy: a council, office, agency, committee or ministry unit. The PATNUC coordinator said in May 2026 that the AI strategic development plan still awaited validation by the competent institutions (CMR-011); the ladder counts the minister's launch of July 2025, so it is read as adopted.
cells.note: The minister launched the strategy at the July 2025 consultations (CMR-002, CMR-005), which meets stage 3 as the ladder words it, though a May 2026 statement has its validation pending. No body is named to carry it out, so not stage 4.
